configurationRules.rule: Every client installation runs nopCommerce 5.00.1 on .NET 10; packs use 5.00.1 setting keys and permission names (for example returnrequestsettings.*, News.Manage); plugin.json SupportedVersions is 5.00.

The native separate cart per vendor stays off in every client pack: shoppingcartsettings.vendorenabled = false and shoppingcartsettings.vendorrequired = false (the installation default). With vendorenabled on, the cart page shows one chosen vendor's items (admin label "Vendor filtering"); with both on, checkout of a cart with more than one vendor is blocked until one vendor is chosen. The product keeps one cart whose order and payment are split across sellers (CHK-004 order splitter, SPLIT-PAY).
configurationRules.mechanism: ShoppingCartSettings.VendorEnabled / VendorRequired (Libraries/Nop.Core/Domain/Orders/ShoppingCartSettings.cs:131,136; defaults Libraries/Nop.Services/Installation/InstallRequiredData.cs:1856-1857); cart filter Presentation/Nop.Web/Factories/ShoppingCartModelFactory.cs:997-1000; warning ShoppingCart.SelectVendorToCheckout (Libraries/Nop.Services/Orders/ShoppingCartService.cs:1220-1226)

configurationRules.rule: Customer and company prices (CAT-039, CAT-042) are native price lists (catalogsettings.priceliststrategy chooses MinimalPrice or UseByPriority). Per-currency fixed prices remain a build. Natively a tier price replaces the price-list price, so a rule is required wherever a product carries both; the rule text is owned by the CAT chapter (column 4).
